item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00227","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C18","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.86,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Written one day before the child, it uses a closely matching rhetorical structure: praise for Americans' voluntary humanitarian action, description of concern for fellow people, reference to the American National Red Cross, discussion of aid benefiting youth, and a concluding affirmation of continued voluntary generosity. Several lexical echoes—especially “heart-warming/heartwarming,” “voluntarily/voluntary,” “concern,” and humanitarian concern for fellow people—make the relationship more concrete than shared charitable subject matter alone. C18 is a weaker parallel involving private American resources supplementing government humanitarian action; C14 shares the foreign-aid and bilateral-friendship framing but lacks the child's distinctive voluntary-relief language.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Your heartwarming preliminary report of our Nation's voluntary relief efforts in Chile","parent_excerpt":"The support given by you and your personnel in the past has been heart-warming. I know that Government employees will continue their fine record of voluntary giving.","explanation":"Distinctive paired use of heartwarming language and voluntary public generosity."},{"child_excerpt":"the united response of Americans--of all creeds and races--to their neighbors in need","parent_excerpt":"Government personnel demonstrated their individual concern for the health and welfare of their fellow men","explanation":"Both characterize voluntary aid as Americans' concern for other people in need."},{"child_excerpt":"a most human supplement to the official relief actions taken by our Government","parent_excerpt":"We, in Government, must bear our full citizens' share in the great humanitarian efforts","explanation":"Both coordinate voluntary humanitarian participation with the government's role."},{"child_excerpt":"the needs of the 80,000 stricken school children of Chile and the major effort by our young people on their behalf","parent_excerpt":"We are also able to strengthen various recreational and character-building groups working among our youth.","explanation":"Both turn from general charitable relief to a specific emphasis on youth."},{"child_excerpt":"The total value of cash and supplies donated by our people was most gratifying to me.","parent_excerpt":"Government personnel... voluntarily helping to raise part of the record $455,000,000 collected throughout the Nation","explanation":"Both praise the measurable scale of voluntary donations."}]}
